Each test case is designed to validate the functionality and accuracy of the flow sensor and pressure sensor under various conditions, as well as the support for the pre-test mode in both the controller and GUI.
```python
import pytest
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

@pytest.mark.parametrize("blower_speed, expected_flow_rate", [
    ("set_speed", "Expected flow rate at set speed as specified in RW-SW-161"),
    ("low_speed", "Expected flow rate at low speed as specified in RW-SW-161"),
    ("high_speed", "Expected flow rate at high speed as specified in RW-SW-161"),
])
def test_flow_sensor_accuracy(blower_speed, expected_flow_rate):
    with patch('path.to.flow_sensor.measure_flow_rate', return_value=expected_flow_rate):
        actual_flow_rate = flow_sensor.measure_flow_rate(blower_speed)
        assert actual_flow_rate == expected_flow_rate, f"Flow rate at {blower_speed} should be {expected_flow_rate}"
```
